OpenPlexer v0.1.0-rc.1 is a pre-alpha release candidate.

- The published Apple silicon binaries passed the hook, audit, and macOS install checks. The binary run covered 24 signed-bundle and key-selection cases and 206 policy decision cases. See the report for the 71 policy cases outside full binary coverage.
- Claude Code 2.1.327 and Codex 0.169.0 passed the live multi-agent flow with the published binaries. Other agent versions are unsupported for this RC.
- A rebuild of the tag with Go 1.27.4 on Apple silicon produced a SHA256SUMS byte-identical to the published manifest.
- Hooks cover selected tools. The hub holds data for one team. Trusted audit checkpoints cover records only through their signed count. The Windows install remains unverified.

[Full checks, supported versions, and known limits](https://github.com/Multiplexer-si/OpenPlexer/blob/main/docs/releases/v0.1.0-rc.1.md)
